root_idea.summary: A semantic orientation toward return, reversion, or restoration to a prior, proper, or associated state.
root_idea.development: The evidence develops this orientation through the return of people to obedience, the returning movement of shade, and property restored or transferred as fayʾ. A related nominal branch describes a group whose members return to one another for mutual support.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Distinct Quran-attested Form IV causative verb.
Distinct Quran-attested Form V verb with a shade-related construction.

senses.definition: To return or revert to a sound, proper, or commanded course.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, the subject returns to God's command, obedience, or what is right; the verb can also describe returning to an affair or state.

senses.definition: To resume conjugal relations with one's wife after an oath of abstention, thereby reverting from the oath.
senses.usage_conditions: A conventional legal construction in the passage concerning īlāʾ; the return entails expiation of the oath.

senses.definition: To cause property to revert to, or be granted to, a party as fayʾ—spoils or property transferred to them.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrences concern property granted by God as fayʾ; in the al-Ḥashr context this particularly concerns property obtained without fighting.

senses.definition: Of shadows, to shift or incline as they return and move with the sun.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic construction is used of created shadows and their changing direction; it does not by itself mean a general human inclination.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To return to kind treatment of, or become favorably inclined and affectionate toward, a relation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational use describing renewed kindness or affection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reconsider an affair or case.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of returning to a matter for renewed judgment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of shade, to shift or return toward the opposite side after midday.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical Form I use of shade, distinct from the supplied Quranic Form V occurrence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a tree, to have abundant shade.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A usage describing the quantity of shade provided by the tree.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an iron implement, to become blunt after having been sharp.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive use describing the loss of sharpness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take booty or spoil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form I use distinct from causing property to be granted as fayʾ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make shade return in the afternoon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative Form II use with shade as the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To set in motion or stir; of wind, to move seed-bearing plants and trees, and of a woman, to move her hair in vanity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The particular objects and contexts are lexical examples of the causative motion use, not general semantic restrictions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause something to return, or to turn someone toward an affair after he had wanted another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general causative Form IV use outside the Quranic property-and-spoils construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take property as spoil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form X use, with property understood as being taken as fayʾ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Afternoon shade: shade after the sun has declined from the meridian, especially what the sun has left behind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is connected with the notion of returning because the shade shifts from side to side. Plurals include أَفْيَاءٌ and فُيُوءٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Booty, spoil, or property transferred from one party to another; especially property obtained without difficult fighting, including certain tax or tribute.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the technical noun fayʾ, including the Quranic use for property restored to the Muslim community without combat; the supplied QAC form groups contain no nominal group for it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A flock or ordered formation of birds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective noun for birds, also described as a row or formation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An expression of regret or wonder, equivalent to “O my wonder!”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic exclamation with variant pronunciation reported in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A party, portion, or distinct body of people; especially a mutually supporting group that has recourse to its members for aid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In military contexts it may denote a company or supporting division; the word has no ordinary proper singular in some analyses. The supplied QAC form groups contain no nominal group for it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hard date-stone after it has passed through cattle and emerged as it was before.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized expression, ذو فَيْئَةٍ, based on the notion of returning to the original state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A time or period.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a synonym of حِينٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kite or similar bird of prey that seizes chickens.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized bird name, also described as a bird resembling an eagle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The time or occasion of something; by extension, the wake or track of a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression for entering on someone's تَفِيئَةٌ means entering shortly after or in his footsteps.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Something made into fayʾ; also, a person whose country, province, or town has been conquered and become fayʾ to the Muslims.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-result noun or description associated with conquest and transfer into the fayʾ category.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who makes a thing, country, or similar possession into fayʾ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agent noun for causing property or territory to become fayʾ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek shade, enter shade, or shelter oneself in the shade of a tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a shade expression or with a tree as the means of obtaining shade.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have recourse to someone for protection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of taking shelter in shade.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bend or incline in a languid manner.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a branch or twig and similar languid bending.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To approach sexually or have sexual intercourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional intimate use describing a coy or languid approach to a spouse; the construction is stated neutrally rather than restricted by the illustrative subject.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or pursue something repeatedly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used, for example, of repeatedly seeking news or tidings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of afternoon shade, or a place on which the sun does not fall.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Variant forms refer to the same shade-place term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An idiot or intellectually deficient person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative description explained as deriving from remaining long or much in the shade.

cautions: The supplied QAC form groups contain only verbs; nominal lexical items such as فَيْءٌ and فِئَةٌ are therefore retained as classical lexical meanings rather than assigned QAC form groups.

A Lane shade citation written as “Kur-án xvi. 50” has not been converted into a modern verse location or used as a Form I Quran occurrence. The securely supplied Quran location for the shade construction is 16:48 under Form V.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The Lane Form I shade unit cites the Quran using historical notation as “xvi. 50,” but the packet independently supplies no matching modern QAC location for a Form I occurrence. Its shade meaning is represented classically, while the Quranic Form V shade sense is supported by the explicit Mufradat discussion and QAC location 16:48.
